title: Oni Demon Rampage
description: A fierce blue oni demon with glowing white tattoos, green hair, and horns stands dynamically in a destroyed traditional Japanese room. It wields two large curved blades, emits energy from its mouth, and is surrounded by smoke, red paw prints, debris, and fleeing shadowy figures under a dramatic purple sky.
prompt: A powerful blue-skinned oni demon with glowing white and pink tribal tattoos across its muscular body, long flowing green hair, sharp horns, and glowing green eyes, standing in an aggressive pose inside a destroyed traditional Japanese wooden room with broken beams and red pillars. The oni wields two large curved blades, one raised high and one low, with energy beams and sparks shooting from its open mouth and clawed hand. White smoke swirls around its hooves leaving red paw prints on the wooden floor, while shadowy human figures flee in terror and debris flies through the air. Dramatic cinematic lighting with purple and red tones in the background, highly detailed digital fantasy art.
